By Data Skrive ,

A three-game series between the Colorado Rockies and the San Francisco Giants will start on Friday, May 29 at 8:40 p.m. ET.
Rockies vs. Giants Series Info Giants @ Rockies Time: Friday, May 29 at 8:40 p.m. ET Rockies Starting Pitcher: Michael Lorenzen Giants Starting Pitcher: Adrian Houser TV Channel : Rockies.TV and NBCS-BA Livestream: Fubo Giants @ Rockies Time: Saturday, May 30 at 9:10 p.m. ET Giants Starting Pitcher: Adrian Houser TV Channel : Rockies.TV and NBCS-BA Livestream: Fubo Giants @ Rockies Time: Sunday, May 31 at 3:10 p.m. ET Rockies Starting Pitcher: Tanner Gordon Giants Starting Pitcher: Robbie Ray TV Channel : Rockies.TV and NBCS-BA Livestream: Fubo How to Bet on Rockies vs. Giants Games Rockies vs. Giants Betting Insights The Rockies have not been moneyline favorites so far this season. Colorado has been the underdog in 55 games this season and won 20 (36.4%) of those contests. The Giants have won 38.5% of the games this season when they were the moneyline favorite (5-8). San Francisco has entered the game as underdogs 34 times this season and won 13, or 38.2%, of those games.
